lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct vertical white line segments are visible across the lateral torso; spacing is uneven, with greater density in the mid-torso/ribcage area and wider gaps towards the hindquarters.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several vertical lines in the central torso region exhibit fragmentation and fail to bridge the full distance between the dorsal fringe and the ventral underbelly.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A sparse cluster of approximately 3-5 white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, situated immediately above the transition to the tawny leg hair.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns show a distinct lyrate spiral, curving laterally and posteriorly from the frontal bone with a visible twist in the ridge structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive white-tipped dorsal mane extending from the neck to the rump; prominent white patches on the muzzle and a white chevron mark between the eyes.
